composition: centered original head-and-shoulders anime avatar; readable iris motifs; circular-crop safe
creative_direction: Illustrate Giyu Tomioka holding a plain small teacup low at chest height, with his familiar dark hair framing a composed adult face. Use a simplified version of his asymmetric outer garment over an ordinary fully covering dark shirt. His shoulders are relaxed, and his mouth softens into the slightest smile. Keep both eyes visible beneath the fringe. Use a detailed animation finish with controlled teal ambient light, careful hair strands, and restrained fabric patterns. The cup should be secondary, with one clearly drawn hand. A quiet pale background plane prevents the dark hair from disappearing. Give both visible irises clear red patterns and bright catchlights. Behind the shoulders only, add two separate abstract black flame-shaped light ornaments for Amaterasu; they touch and burn nothing. Original nonviolent fan-art portrait, square 1024x1024, centered for a circular avatar crop. No text, watermark, weapons, distress, or copied scene.
style_inspiration: New text-only fan-art composition; no existing frame, panel, promotional artwork or image pixels copied.
